title: Photo Duo 086 · 아워글래스 USSBBW × 텐트폴 USSBBW · 둘 다 눕기 (머리 반대)
prompt:
Image format: a horizontal landscape-orientation photograph, 3:2 aspect ratio, wider than it is tall.

A photograph of TWO women lying on one low flat platform, a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, the camera set close at platform level so the two of them fill the frame edge to edge, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subjects: TWO real adult women, both far beyond any real person in size, lying on their sides one behind the other and both facing the camera but head to toe in opposite directions — the nearer woman's head at the left edge and the farther woman's head at the right edge, so that each one's shoulders sit behind the other one's legs and their bulk fills the frame evenly from edge to edge and top to bottom.

Nearer woman, head at the left: a Latina woman in her late 40s, warm golden-tan skin with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, waist-length locs with gold cuffs. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward. Below it an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and, even as she lies on her side, spills forward away from her body and hangs over the front edge of her torso, the lowest part sagging onto the platform in three or four heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Colossal hips more than three times the width of that waistline and a gigantic rear, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist. Her upper hip rises as a great rounded mound higher than her own shoulder, the underside hip and thigh flattening wide against the platform. Painted in Japanese maki-e lacquer — glossy black lacquer with sprinkled gold powder shading into autumn grasses, chrysanthemums and full moons, bold gold bands following every curve.

Farther woman, head at the right: an East African woman in her late 20s, deep umber skin with a warm sheen, her face exactly the same tone as her body, long finger waves past her shoulders. A giant hourglass frame flaring out at both ends: enormous flaring lats spreading to shoulders twice the width of a normal woman's, huge thick arms pushed far out by the width of her back, a colossal bust projecting past the line of her shoulders, no waist at all. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and, even as she lies on her side, spills forward away from her body and hangs over the front edge of her torso, the lowest part sagging onto the platform in two or three heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Below it colossal wide hips just as broad as her shoulders and a huge rounded rear; the muscle is rounded and soft-edged under a thick layer of fat. Her upper hip rises as a great rounded mound higher than her own shoulder, the underside hip and thigh flattening wide against the platform. Painted in polished malachite — vivid emerald and deep forest green in concentric swirling bands following every curve like contour lines on a map, a thin gold line between them.

Each rests her head on her raised hand with that elbow planted behind her body, her other arm lifted clear on the top of her hip with the elbow raised, a visible gap of background between that arm and her side. On both: real photographic skin with visible pores, creases where the flesh folds and faint stretch marks, no illustration finish, no CG sheen. The paint is pigment on living skin, distorting over every bulge and cracking where it folds, covering everything below the jaw with no bare skin left; their faces unpainted, the pattern fading out at the neck. Neither arm crosses in front of her own body or the other woman's, both faces toward the camera. Every fold keeps its own rounded outline with a deep crease between them, never one shapeless mass; arms, hands and legs in correct proportion. Both wear extreme platform stiletto heels with soles as tall as their ankle bones.

Horizontal 3:2 landscape-orientation photograph, wider than it is tall.
